name: ChatGPT Health
desc: Connect your health records and Apple Health, then ask about them.
desc_zh: 接入病历和 Apple Health 数据，然后直接向 ChatGPT 提问。
solves: Lab results and sleep data sit in five different apps. Health puts them in one dashboard so a question about a new result can be answered against your own history.
solves_zh: 化验单和睡眠数据散在五六个 App 里。Health 把它们放进同一块面板，问到新结果时能对着你自己的历史记录回答。
best_for: An appointment is coming up and you want your own numbers in front of you.
best_for_zh: 快复诊了，你想把自己的各项数据先摆在一起看。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — ChatGPT release notes, https://help.openai.com/en/articles/6825453-chatgpt-r）。 ChatGPT release notes, entry under the "July 23, 2026" heading. Consumer health surface. Distinct from ChatGPT for Healthcare and ChatGPT for Clinicians, which are the organisation-facing products. 首次公开日期来源：https://help.openai.com/en/articles/6825453-chatgpt-release-notes
